title: Efron type identities for stopping sets and Poisson hulls
summary: We consider a Poisson process $η$ on a general Borel space with intensity measure $λ$ and a stopping set $Z$ depending on $η$. Generalizing earlier results we prove a spatial Markov property for $Z$. In fact we establish this property for the larger class of finitely insertion tolerant random sets, which include pointwise limits of stopping sets. Using the spatial Markov property of $η$, we derive several distributional identities for the restrictions of $η$ and $λ$ to $Z$ and the complement of $Z$. An important special case in Euclidean space is the convex hull of a finite Poisson process.…
